fixture_notice: Synthetic methodology manifest; no real analysis is represented.

rules.summary: Select independently checkable assertions; preserve values and anecdotes without truth-scoring them.
Editor-reviewed exact repeats and paraphrases contribute one denominator unit.
Record supporting, contradicting, and contextual evidence with source-quality fields.
Separate accuracy, framing, causal support, and uncertainty instead of one opaque score.
Hide aggregate scores until publication gates clear and no reviewed findings remain unresolved.
